5191.title: Browser session denies local connection permissions
5191.rootCauseOneLine: Both desktop browser session permission handlers grant only clipboard-sanitized-write and deny local-network-access, local-network, and loopback-network without an origin consent path.
5191.proposedFix: Choose an origin-scoped local-connection consent policy, share its decision between both session handlers, and test approved and unapproved origins while preserving default denial. This changes a permission/security boundary and is not eligible for an automated simple fix.
5191.caveats: Permission denial repeated in two clean trusted checkouts; the macOS Okta Verify sign-in flow was not exercised because neither macOS nor an enrolled Okta test identity was available. Existing manager tests pass 77/77.
